items.title: Leur décès nous rappelle l'importance de ne jamais conduire avec les capacités affaiblies : La campagne Opération ruban rouge de MADD Canada invite tout le monde à s’engager en faveur de la conduite sobre
items.summary: MADD Canada launches its 39th annual Operation Red Ribbon campaign to promote sober driving during the holiday season. The campaign honors Suparna and Suranjan Das, who were killed in an alcohol-related collision in 2022. For the first time, campaign materials are available in Bengali, French, and English. From November 1, 2026 to January 4, 2027, volunteers will distribute red ribbons and car stickers while organizing local events to raise awareness and funds. Nearly 50 landmarks across Canada will be illuminated in red to honor victims and support survivors.

items.title: 2026 National Poppy Campaign launches with a donation “first” … and stunning mural: Don’t forget to Remember
items.summary: The Royal Canadian Legion launched its 2026 National Poppy Campaign with new tap-on-phone contactless donation technology supported by BMO. A 4x7 metre mural featuring handwritten messages from Canadians was unveiled at Union Station in Toronto, honoring WWI veteran Allan McLean Davidson. The campaign includes multiple donation methods through partners like RBC, Amazon Canada, Starbucks, and TD Bank, with proceeds supporting Canadian Veterans and their families.

items.title: 21shares Announces 1-for-10 Reverse Share Split for 21Shares 2x Long Dogecoin ETF (TXXD)
items.summary: 21shares announced a 1-for-10 reverse share split for its 21Shares 2x Long Dogecoin ETF (TXXD), effective after market close on September 4, 2026. The split will reduce outstanding shares by approximately 90% while increasing per-share NAV and market price by a factor of ten. The adjustment is purely structural and does not affect shareholders' total investment value.
